protocol.name: public_photo_autonomous_mission_v1
protocol.goal: Produce current-version machine findings and an inspectable digital evidence package.
protocol.revision_policy: R2 is fixed before execution, never inferred or silently approved from an AI count.
protocol.uncertainty_policy: Stop that case at needs_more_evidence; do not repeatedly infer the same pixels to force agreement.
protocol.timing: Server monotonic for the entire mission, includes preparation and all model waits; restart is unknown.
protocol.scope: Known public development photos; engineering execution, not a new accuracy or human benefit study.

limitations: This is automatic engineering execution on previously exposed public development photos; human participants = 0.
The rule planner routes real model findings. It does not certify correctness, independently review the image, or repair a scene.
Same-photo R2 replay is declared simulation, not a new capture. No physical completion or user-efficiency claim.
An archived finding describes its saved snapshot. A later order, photo, check or runtime change makes it historical.
